title: 8.09 Classical Mechanics III
authors: Iain Stewart (instructor; author of the chapter notes)
description: Third undergraduate mechanics course (also taken by graduate students as 8.309): review of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics with constraints and conservation laws, rigid body dynamics, vibrations, canonical transformations, Hamilton-Jacobi theory and action-angle variables, perturbation theory, fluid mechanics, and chaos. Seven chapters of typed lecture notes plus problem sets.
rightsNotes: Content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by MIT OpenCourseWare (licence link in the page footer; terms page quotes the licence). Attribution and share-alike are required and commercial use is excluded. Corniversity is private and non-commercial.
The chapter notes are PDFs on ocw.mit.edu and may be fetched for personal study and citation. Problem sets are listed on the Assignments page; they were not opened and are not copied.
The syllabus names Goldstein, Poole and Safko, Classical Mechanics (Pearson, 2013) as the main text and lists further commercial books; Corniversity does not require any of them.
